title: Projections of a limit with affine transition maps are affine; limits restrict to opens of a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ ($i\ge i'$) an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $(S,(f_i)_{i\in I})$ be a limit of the system in the category of schemes [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then (1) each projection $f_i:S\to S_i$ is affine; (2) for every $0\in I$ and every open $U_0\subseteq S_0$, the open subschemes $f_{i0}^{-1}(U_0)\subseteq S_i$ ($i\ge0$) with the restricted transition morphisms $f_{i0}^{-1}(U_0)\to f_{i'0}^{-1}(U_0)$ ($i\ge i'\ge0$) form an inverse system over $I_{\ge0}$ whose transition morphisms are affine, and $f_0^{-1}(U_0)\subseteq S$ with the restricted projections $f_0^{-1}(U_0)\to f_{i0}^{-1}(U_0)$ is its limit in the category of schemes.
